lines.text: Cyber safety. Four things every student must know.
First, digital arrest is a scam. No police officer or agency arrests anyone, or demands money, over a phone or video call.
Next, never share your OTP, UPI PIN or card details. You never need a PIN to receive money.
Also, genuine employers do not ask for registration fees or security deposits for a job.
And remember, if someone threatens you online, do not pay. Save the chats, block the account and report it. It is not your fault.
The National Cyber Crime Helpline number is 1930.
You can also report cybercrime online at cybercrime.gov.in.
